messages:
Anna L: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR for the retention examples + SDK snippets. Need a SOC2-friendly phrasing check and a short migration example for legacy customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
Jordan M: Thanks Anna — pinging @sarah.legal for wording. I skimmed and we should avoid saying 'permanent erase' in the public docs.
Sarah.legal: Agree. Suggest we use 'retention TTL' and 'secure deletion' language. Example line: 'Redwood retains audit logs for the configured retention TTL; records are securely deleted according to our data disposal policy.' Don’t promise irrecoverability for customer-managed backups.
Priya S: Got it. I drafted two SDK snippets — python and curl — for setting TTL. Python draft: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.set_retention("audit_logs", ttl_days=30)
```
Curl draft: ```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retention 
  -d '{"resource":"audit_logs","ttl_days":30}'
```
Kai W: Quick API nit — our Go SDK currently uses `ttl` instead of `ttl_days`. We should align names or docs will be confusing. I can either change the SDK param to `ttl_days` or update the snippets to `ttl`.
Jordan M: I prefer changing the SDK param for clarity; `ttl_days` is explicit. If Kai can bump a patch we can land docs that match the published client.
docs-bot: PR opened: redwood-inference/docs#1234 by @Anna L — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — reviewers: @Priya S, @Jordan M
Anna L: Per @sarah.legal I'll update the sentence to the suggested phrasing and add a short note about exports + redaction link. Also I'll change the python snippet to include a brief comment about what the TTL affects.
Jordan M: Can we add a tiny migration snippet for customers using the legacy `auditRetention` field? Something like: ```bash
# map old field to new TTL_days in a json transform
jq '.ttl_days = (.auditRetention // .legacyRetention // 30)' old-config.json > new-config.json
```
Priya S: LGTM. I'll add a unit test in snippets repo to ensure examples render and the JSON examples validate.
Kai W: I'll update Go + Python SDKs to use `ttl_days` and cut a patch release today. When the client version lands, let me know and I'll post the new release note.
Anna L: Thanks — assigning final review to @Priya S once Kai's release is out. I won't merge until doc examples match published SDK names.
Jordan M: Small accessibility nit — add a short alt-text line for code blocks in the HTML output so screen-readers get context.
Priya S: Good call. I'll add `aria-label` comments in the generated snippet wrapper.
Sarah.legal: One more micro-ask: in the compliance section, replace 'we delete' with 'records are securely deleted in accordance with our Data Disposal Policy' and link to the policy.
Anna L: Will do. ETA for doc update: end of day. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Kai W: Patch release created, version 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4. Ping me when the docs PR is green and I'll confirm compatibility. :shipit:
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #1234 — checks: lint, build, snippet-tests
Anna L: CI green, merging once @Priya S signs off on the accessibility change.
Priya S: Signed off. Merging now. :white_check_mark:
Anna L: Merged and synced to main. Noted for the release notes: "Retention API: parameter rename to ttl_days; documentation updated with SOC2-friendly wording and migration snippet."
